remarks: Gorgeous and spacious two bedroom apartment in East Norwalk. Large living and eating space with a private porch. Laundry in unit and a walk up attic with tons of storage. Two reserved parking spots in private/paved lot right out front. Perfect for commuters, block away from East Norwalk Train Station and I95. Walk or bike to all East Norwalk & SONO amenities, beaches (Calf Pasture & Shady), shops, restaurants, SoNo nightlife, Maritime Museum & Aquarium, the SoNo Collection Mall. Submit rental application, credit report, employment verification, photo ID & references through Rent Spree. Pets are welcome. Tenant pays electric and propane.

facts.laundryLoc: Washer/Dryer are private and in unit.
